title: Module: VPC observability Terraform with guarded rollouts and smoke-checks
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that deploys a standardized observability stack into customer VPC K8s clusters (or EKS/GKE provisioned infra) with opinionated defaults and built-in upgrade/health gating. The module must package: Prometheus (operator or helm), Grafana (helm), an OpenTelemetry Collector deployment configured for batching and secure egress, and a configurable log-shipping path (Fluent Bit or Vector) that forwards to our log ingestion endpoints or S3/Loki backends. Key constraints: all resources must be deployable in private subnets, support customer KMS for secrets, and avoid breaking schema changes during upgrades.
comments: 2025-02-12 - Marisol Vega: Created ticket. Initial scope and acceptance criteria added. Goal: module to be safe for tenant upgrades (canary + automated smoke checks) and support private-only egress via NAT or VPC endpoints.

2025-02-14 - Ethan Park: Spike completed for helm_release pattern. Chose helm provider + local values templating to maintain drift visibility. Noted challenge: helm provider forces large diff for chart repo checksum changes; proposing lifecycle.ignore_changes for chart_metadata but not for configmaps.

2025-02-18 - Priya Nair (Reviewer): Suggested adding pre-upgrade plan validations: (1) verify Prometheus CRD compatibility, (2) ensure Grafana datasource migrations are idempotent. Also requested a small migration harness to run in CI prior to applying to prod.

2025-02-22 - QA (Liam Chen): Implemented smoke-test job in CI that runs after terraform apply; checks (a) prometheus & grafana pods ready, (b) otel collector can connect to ingestion endpoint via test certificate, (c) logs are visible in staging ingestion with tag test-deploy.

2025-02-26 - Security (Anya Sokolov): Reviewed KMS integration and RBAC for collector service account. Required explicit IAM role binding for S3 write and KMS decrypt; flagged need for documented key rotation procedure.

2025-03-01 - Ethan Park: Merged initial module scaffolding into infra/telemetry. Next: add canary traffic gating and terraform apply-stage automation for canary -> full rollout path. Blockers: one flaky e2e that times out waiting for Prometheus rules to render.

2025-03-01 - Marisol Vega: Logged follow-ups: create runbook for rollback, add sentinel policy to prevent unapproved major grafana version bumps, add terraform-plan guard with cost estimate for hosted ingestion egress.
2025-03-01 - QA (Liam Chen): Note: smoke-tests are temporarily allowed to be non-blocking for experimental tenants while we tune readiness probes and collector batch settings.
